name: Atal'ai Artifact
summary: Atal'ai Artifacts lie scattered in the Pool of Tears around the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Fel'zerul seeks them to learn what magic the Atal'ai practiced there.

sections.title: Relics in the Pool
sections.body: Dark waters surround the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows. Atal'ai Artifacts rest in the Pool of Tears, where Fel'zerul of Stonard seeks them. The Atal'ai were dark casters, and the magic used within their temple was powerful. These relics may help Fel'zerul understand what the trolls sought to accomplish.

faq.answer: Atal'ai Artifacts lie in the Pool of Tears around the sunken Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Fel'zerul in Stonard seeks Atal'ai Artifacts so he can study the magic used by the Atal'ai.
Fel'zerul hopes the artifacts will help him understand what the Atal'ai trolls were trying to accomplish with their powerful magic.
The Atal'ai were a tribe of trolls known for practicing forbidden magic.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, Fel'zerul asks you to help investigate the sunken temple and study the Atal'ai's powerful magic.
